subject: CVE-2025-3511
object: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Mitsubishi Electric Corporation CC-Link IE TSN Remote I/O module, CC-Link IE TSN Analog-Digital Converter module, CC-Link IE TSN Digital-Analog Converter module, CC-Link IE TSN FPGA module, CC-Link IE TSN Remote Station Communication LSI CP620 with GbE-PHY, MELSEC iQ-R Series CC-Link IE TSN Master/Local Module, MELSEC iQ-R Series Ethernet Interface Module, CC-Link IE TSN Master/Local Station Communication LSI CP610, MELSEC iQ-F Series FX5 CC-Link IE TSN Master/Local Module, MELSEC iQ-F Series FX5 Ethernet Module, MELSEC iQ-F Series FX5-ENET/IP Ethernet Module, and MELSEC iQ-R Series CPU module allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a Denial of Service condition in the products by sending specially crafted UDP packets.
object_canonical: improper validation of specified quantity in input vulnerability in mitsubishi electric corporation cc-link ie tsn remote i/o module, cc-link ie tsn analog-digital converter module, cc-link ie tsn digital-analog converter module, cc-link ie tsn fpga module, cc-link ie tsn remote station communication lsi cp620 with gbe-phy, melsec iq-r series cc-link ie tsn master/local module, melsec iq-r series ethernet interface module, cc-link ie tsn master/local station communication lsi cp610, melsec iq-f series fx5 cc-link ie tsn master/local module, melsec iq-f series fx5 ethernet module, melsec iq-f series fx5-enet/ip ethernet module, and melsec iq-r series cpu module allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service condition in the products by sending specially crafted udp packets.
